test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 02 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2
solution:
The correct answer is** 'synonyms'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In this context, '**synonyms**' is the most appropriate word because the writer initially believed that '**hearing**' and '**listening**' had similar meanings.
 
• Synonyms are words that have similar or the same meanings in a language.
 
• The other terms, '**antonyms**', '**homonyms**', and '**acronyms**' do not fit into this context as they describe different relationships or types of words.
 
• The writer's realization that '**hearing**' and '**listening**' aren't the same demonstrates that they initially considered them synonymous.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• 'Synonym' comes from the Greek ‘syn’ (meaning 'same') and 'onym' (meaning 'name'). Together, they imply words that mean the same.
